comments: Free online tool, no account required. Built on axe-core.
features: Free online checker that scans a web page for WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 (A and AA) issues using the axe-core engine. Lists each issue with its impact, the affected element and how to fix it, plus a 0-100 score. No signup needed. Optional monitoring re-checks your sites on a schedule and alerts you to new issues.
title: Uptura Accessibility Checker
